'''Barium liquid''' was a product served [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] alongside roast [[Smapp]] at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster's]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on<ref name="Dex" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Foodstuff/Legends|meal]] cost 8.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was served on [[Zhellday/Legends|Zhelldays]] as one of the two options for [[Diet/Legends|lunch]] and dinner [[Pantoran Plate Specials]].<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|''Note'': In the cool winter periods, a hot barium liquid accompanies this dish quite nicely.|A recipe for a Smapp-based dish|<ref name="Monsters">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref>}}
Barium liquid was first mentioned in the [[1993]] book ''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]'', a publication that combines creature designs and photographs from various projects of [[George Lucas]], creator of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise, with original text by [[Bob Carrau]]. In the book, the product is mentioned in an [[in-universe]] recipe that suggests pairing a dish made out of a Smapp creature with hot barium liquid during cool [[Winter/Legends|winters]].<ref name="Monsters" /> [[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], has indicated that information contained in ''Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas'' is [[Canon|non-canonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=Unless referred to by a source that is in-continuity, the information is non-continuity.}} {{C|In response to: "And is information from Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas canon?"}}</ref>

[[File:BariumRealWorld.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A sample of pure real-world barium]]
In [[2009]], barium liquid was introduced into ''Star Wars'' Legends canon via "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive [[StarWars.com]] article that was written by [[Gregory Walker]].<ref name="Dex" /> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Barium|barium]] is a [[Wikipedia:Chemical element|chemical element]] and [[Wikipedia:Metal|metal]] with a [[Wikipedia:melting point|melting point]] of 727 degrees [[Wikipedia:Celsius|Celsius]] (1,341 degrees [[Wikipedia:Fahrenheit|Fahrenheit]]) that, in nature, is always found in the form of [[Wikipedia:Chemical compound|chemical compounds]]. All [[Wikipedia:Solubility|soluble]] barium compounds are toxic to [[Wikipedia:Mammal|mammals]], whereas the insoluble [[Wikipedia:Barium sulfate|barium sulfate]] is used as a [[Wikipedia:Radiocontrast agent|radiocontrast agent]] in [[Wikipedia:Upper gastrointestinal series|X-ray imaging]] of the human [[Wikipedia:Gastrointestinal tract|gastrointestinal tract]].<ref name="BariumBritannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/science/barium|text=Barium &#124; Uses, Compounds, & Facts|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2024-06-14|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20240226155412}}</ref>
